applicationId.description: The id of the application to update the source of. Example: "3ae2b801-19f6-41ef-ad28-214bd731948f"

actions.description: Move an application to another interview stage.
actions.name: change-application-stage

applicationId.description: The id of the application to update the stage of. Example: "3ae2b801-19f6-41ef-ad28-214bd731948f"

interviewStageId.description: The interview stage to move the application to. Example: "2c6991c5-c9e2-4af8-879e-29c5a9d26509"

archiveReasonId.description: Archive reason to set when moving to an Interview Stage with type: Archived. Required when moving to an Archived stage.

archiveEmail.description: Email to send to the candidate when moving to an Interview Stage with type: Archived.

communicationTemplateId.description: The id of the communication template to use for the email.

sendAt.description: ISO 8601 date-time to send the email. If omitted, scheduled for the following morning at 9:32am in the default timezone.

candidateId.description: The id of the candidate to consider for a job. Example: "3ae2b801-19f6-41ef-ad28-214bd731948f"

jobId.description: The id of the job to consider the candidate for. Example: "2c6991c5-c9e2-4af8-879e-29c5a9d26509"

interviewPlanId.description: The id of the interview plan to place the application in.

interviewStageId.description: The interview stage to place the application in.

sourceId.description: The source to set on the application being created.

creditedToUserId.description: The id of the user the application will be credited to.

createdAt.description: An ISO date string to set the application createdAt timestamp.

applicationHistory.description: An array of objects representing the application history.

name.description: The first and last name of the candidate to be created.

email.description: Primary, personal email of the candidate to be created.

phoneNumber.description: Primary, personal phone number of the candidate to be created.

linkedInUrl.description: Url to the candidate's LinkedIn profile.

githubUrl.description: Url to the candidate's Github profile.

alternateEmailAddresses.description: Array of alternate email addresses to add to the candidate profile.

actions.description: Create a candidate note in Ashby.
actions.name: create-note

noteType.description: Content type of the note. Defaults to text/plain.

sendNotifications.description: Whether subscribed users should be notified. Defaults to false.

isPrivate.description: Whether the note should be marked as private. Defaults to false.

createdAt.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp for when the note was created.
